name: Willow
source:
A fellow patient in the Ward and a good friend to [url=https://vndb.org/c150867]Barry[/url]. She has Huntington's Disease.

While sexually uninvolved in Object Ward, she engages with [Spoiler]Father[/Spoiler] in the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony.
